descriptionHtml:
Bug B01 · P0 · new

Photo census scan never finds anyone: the vision model wraps its JSON in a ```json block and parseModelJson (convex/lib/modelJson.ts:98) silently returns nothing (Hospital and Nursing Home)

Tickets: TFA-94425 ready for qa; TFA-92580 rejected by qa; TFA-92587 AC 3 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Also blocks dev U77; U78–U81 paused for the same reason Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92587): it also blocks every Nursing Home scan case on dev (TC-09/S04, S06, S07, S08, S17, S18; dev units U77–U81 paused). Re-check 2026-10-16 on 25acd727: still there (convex/ai/vision.ts, modelJson.ts and vertex.ts unchanged since e02167f). With a scripted read, everything after the read passes locally (TC-09/S04, S06, S07, S17); the cases stay failed until a real photo is read.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-03/S18, TC-09/S04, TC-09/S06, TC-09/S07, TC-09/S08

Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S17 Same-day re-scan of the same supervisor list: nothing is created twice

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 The photo uses the same deduplication against All Residents as TC-02. Before anything is written, the physician sees how many residents are already known and how many are new (e.g. … (UAT TC-09; UAT TC-02 (by reference); TFA-92587 AC 3)
  • U2 Photographing the nursing supervisor's list adds the residents on it to Today's Visits. Residents already in All Residents go onto today's list, and new ones are created. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 3; TFA-92587 How it works 3)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given QA Alder and QA Birch seeded as in S04; in this run the agent first scans supervisor-day1.jpg and confirms, as in S04

When Scan supervisor-day1.jpg again the same day (the physician retakes a better photo) → read the sheet → confirm → Today's Visits → All Residents

Then The second sheet says all 4 residents are already known and none is new. After confirming, each of the four exists once in All Residents and is on Today's Visits

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: s17-rescan-sheet has '4 residents found', '4 already' and '0 new' (U3, no count runner needed); s17-today has all four and mustNotContain 'In Today ✓'; s17-all has all four and 'In Today ✓'. Each name exactly once is a backend read of snf:list (U3 'never duplicating')

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S17 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-09/S17

Same-day re-scan of the same supervisor list: nothing is created twice

Tickets: TFA-92587 All Residents Attendance Toggle (ready for qa)

Re-verdict after the QA review of TFA-92587 (2026-10-16; not yet checked by Quinn): failed. Local 25acd727 with a scripted read (package rst, 2026-10-16): a same-day re-scan reads '4 already · 0 new'; each resident exists once and is on today once. The real read still returns nothing (B01, code unchanged), so a physician scanning a photo sees 'No residents found'. Failed on B01 until the read is fixed. The run's own result was pass; its evidence is below.

New local lane newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

Local, rst-tc09-scans.spec.ts: the real Nursing Home scan sheet with ai/vision:scanCensusSheet answered at the Convex socket with the exact rows the case's photo lists (the photo is a neutral fixture image; the read itself — Vertex / B01 — is not exercised); fresh physician per case, names 'QA TC-09-Sxx <word>' as the matrix asks. Open questions recorded, never judged (brief 2026-10-16): Q1 (the scan replaces today's list), Q6 (a row with no MRN is stored with a generated 'SNF-######' MRN), Q8 (a known name with another MRN), Q2 (count wording). T2 / U9 (Vertex Gemini read the photo; model and AI time logged) cannot be checked locally: the read never reaches the server; the 10-15 dev photo10 run logged them (gemini-3.6-flash, providerMs) but every live read returns no rows (B01, still on 25acd727: convex/ai/vision.ts + convex/lib/modelJson.ts parseModelJson unchanged, no fence stripping, Vertex has no JSON mode). S17: 8/8 judged pass — first scan of the 4 rows (every row prints an MRN) confirmed; the re-scan's sheet says '4 residents found' and '4 already in All Residents · 0 new · 0 to review'; after confirming, each of the four is on Today's Visits once and in All Residents once (backend each exactly once), Alder still keeps Oak 1A and its MRN after two scans.

Evidence: 4 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: permission-add-patient, synthetic-media. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
